data: @InitialSeg.{u_1, u_2} : {α : Type u_1} → {β : Type u_2} → (α → α → Prop) → (β → β → Prop) → Type (max u_1 u_2)
'InitialSeg' does not depend on any axioms

@InitialSeg.le_apply_iff.{u_1,
    u_2} : ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} [inst : PartialOrder.{u_2} β] {a : α} {b : β} [inst_1 : PartialOrder.{u_1} α]
  (f :
    @InitialSeg.{u_1, u_2} α β
      (fun x1 x2 => @LT.lt.{u_1} α (@Preorder.toLT.{u_1} α (@PartialOrder.toPreorder.{u_1} α inst_1)) x1 x2)
      fun x1 x2 => @LT.lt.{u_2} β (@Preorder.toLT.{u_2} β (@PartialOrder.toPreorder.{u_2} β inst)) x1 x2),
  Iff
    (@LE.le.{u_2} β (@Preorder.toLE.{u_2} β (@PartialOrder.toPreorder.{u_2} β inst)) b
      (@DFunLike.coe.{max (u_1 + 1) (u_2 + 1), u_1 + 1, u_2 + 1}
        (@InitialSeg.{u_1, u_2} α β
          (fun x1 x2 => @LT.lt.{u_1} α (@Preorder.toLT.{u_1} α (@PartialOrder.toPreorder.{u_1} α inst_1)) x1 x2)
          fun x1 x2 => @LT.lt.{u_2} β (@Preorder.toLT.{u_2} β (@PartialOrder.toPreorder.{u_2} β inst)) x1 x2)
        α (fun x => β)
        (@InitialSeg.instFunLike.{u_1, u_2} α β
          (fun x1 x2 => @LT.lt.{u_1} α (@Preorder.toLT.{u_1} α (@PartialOrder.toPreorder.{u_1} α inst_1)) x1 x2)
          fun x1 x2 => @LT.lt.{u_2} β (@Preorder.toLT.{u_2} β (@PartialOrder.toPreorder.{u_2} β inst)) x1 x2)
        f a))
    (∃ c,
      And (@LE.le.{u_1} α (@Preorder.toLE.{u_1} α (@PartialOrder.toPreorder.{u_1} α inst_1)) c a)
        (@Eq.{u_2 + 1} β
          (@DFunLike.coe.{max (u_1 + 1) (u_2 + 1), u_1 + 1, u_2 + 1}
            (@InitialSeg.{u_1, u_2} α β
              (fun x1 x2 => @LT.lt.{u_1} α (@Preorder.toLT.{u_1} α (@PartialOrder.toPreorder.{u_1} α inst_1)) x1 x2)
              fun x1 x2 => @LT.lt.{u_2} β (@Preorder.toLT.{u_2} β (@PartialOrder.toPreorder.{u_2} β inst)) x1 x2)
            α (fun x => β)
            (@InitialSeg.instFunLike.{u_1, u_2} α β
              (fun x1 x2 => @LT.lt.{u_1} α (@Preorder.toLT.{u_1} α (@PartialOrder.toPreorder.{u_1} α inst_1)) x1 x2)
              fun x1 x2 => @LT.lt.{u_2} β (@Preorder.toLT.{u_2} β (@PartialOrder.toPreorder.{u_2} β inst)) x1 x2)
            f c)
          b))

@InitialSeg.subsingleton_of_trichotomous_of_irrefl.{u_1,
    u_2} : ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {r : α → α → Prop} {s : β → β → Prop} [@Std.Trichotomous.{u_2 + 1} β s]
  [@Std.Irrefl.{u_2 + 1} β s] [@WellFounded.{u_1 + 1} α r],
  Subsingleton.{max (u_2 + 1) (u_1 + 1)} (@InitialSeg.{u_1, u_2} α β r s)

@InitialSeg.total.{u_1,
    u_2} : {α : Type u_1} →
  {β : Type u_2} →
    (r : α → α → Prop) →
      (s : β → β → Prop) →
        [IsWellOrder.{u_1} α r] →
          [IsWellOrder.{u_2} β s] →
            Sum.{max u_2 u_1, max u_1 u_2} (@InitialSeg.{u_1, u_2} α β r s) (@InitialSeg.{u_2, u_1} β α s r)
